Payment Options
There are five convenient ways for you to pay your property taxes:
Online
Payment Plans
In Person
Escrow
US Mail
Online
Payment Plans
In Person
Escrow
US Mail
Online
Option 1: Pay Online
The Stearns County automated electronic payment system allows you to pay your current real estate and mobile property taxes on our website using either E-Check (free) or Visa / Mastercard / Discover (2.5% service fee). Pay 24 hours a day. Visit Property Access System to pay property taxes online.
Online Payment Instructions
How do I make an online property tax payment?
Step-by-step instructions (pdf file)
Video #1 - Instructional video for basic property tax payments.
Video #2 - Instructional video for more advanced property tax payments: multiple parcels, future scheduled payments, and creating an account to view history.
Video #1 - Basic Property Tax Payments
Video #2 - Advanced Property Tax Payments
Payment Plans
Option 2: Monthly or Quarterly Payment Plans
These payment plans will help you in several ways. Your payments spread out over either a quarterly or a 10 month period. The payments are automatically deducted from your checking or savings account. This saves time, and there are no checks to write. It helps meet your commitment in a convenient and timely manner, even if you're out of town or on vacation. No lost or misplaced statements, and your payment is always on time. There are no late charges. It saves on postage charges. It's easy to sign up for, and easy to cancel. Payment plans are available by selecting: Quarterly Plan (PDF) or 10 month plan (PDF) or by calling 320-656-3870.
In Person
Option 3: In Person
Make your payment by cash, check or money order at either Treasurer's Office (Stearns County Administration Center or Service Center).
Stearns County Administration Building
705 Courthouse Square, Room 136
Saint Cloud, MN 56303

License Center West Drive-Thru accepts current year tax payments.
Escrow
Option 4: Escrow
Your escrow agent may be escrowing your property taxes for you. The escrow agent is responsible for paying your property taxes by the due date. If you aren't sure if your taxes are being escrowed, contact your escrow agent.
US Mail
Option 5: U.S. Mail
Just return your payment stub along with a check or money order for the correct amount to the Treasurer's office. Your payment must be postmarked by the Post Office on or before the due date. If your taxes were not escrowed, pre-addressed envelopes are included with your tax statement.
By sending your check, please be aware that you are authorizing Stearns County to make a one-time electronic debit from your account at the financial institution indicated on your check. This electronic debit will be for the amount of your check; no additional amount will be added to the amount of your check.
Please make your check payable to: Stearns County Auditor - Treasurer
